ellie-cs: Quick health check for NovaQuant — p95 up +120ms, p99 +320ms, cost +22% WoW. Renewal in 10d. Propose short mitigation: route partial traffic to quantized model, set KV prefix TTL, canary for quality. Need eng owners.

matt-eng: OK. Suggest 15% to novaquant-v2-int8, KV TTL 30s, ramp if eval passes. Keep initial share low (10-20%).

kim-ml: int8 risks: drift on long contexts. I'll build a 50-sample eval (long multi-turn + cache-churn prefixes). Return quality diff in ~6h.

stephen-sre: Canary gates: require p99 improvement >=100ms and error rate <= baseline+0.2%. Rollback window 15m. I'll wire alerting and automatic rollback.

sam-devex: I'll prepare SDK snippet, a short runbook for CS to flip weights, and a dev-namespace canary.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: anomaly detected: novaquant-v2 hosted p99 spike at 2026-03-20T02:14:22Z; alert sent to #eng-runtime.

jordan_nova: Thanks — timeline works. If we see early wins please send a 1-paragraph exec note we can share.

ellie-cs: Action owners recap: matt (routing + TTL), kim (eval), sam (runbook + dev canary), stephen (SLOs + alerts). I'll schedule a 30-min check-in in 48h and update renewal brief. Reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes: :rocket:
